label: D1 near episode end (low value) after a rare a1->S2 transition
explanation: Fires only at D1 (fixation step), almost exclusively in the last ~10 trials of the episode (99.9% of mass at ep_trial 90-99; none before trial 80), when the model value head is low (all activations have value < 5.2, the bottom value bin, which reflects little remaining reward). Within that, it needs the previous trial to have been a1 followed by a rare transition to S2 (prev_action 1, prev_common 0: 90% of mass). Previous reward modulates it weakly (more on unrewarded, but both fire). Using the model value as an observed proxy for episode end (value < 4) gives dev P 0.73 / R 0.86 / F1 0.79 / mass recall 0.90; ep_trial >= 95 instead gives F1 0.68. Magnitude grows as value falls (value < 3 gives precision 0.97). It never fires at GO or D2, after a common transition, or after an a2 choice. All variables are observable (value is the model output; prev trial action/transition are seen).
